title: Motion Equivariant Convolutional LSTM: When Motion Becomes a Gauge Symmetry
abstract: arXiv:2610.28771v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Objects move, cameras pan, and weather drifts with the wind: much of what changes in sequential data is motion. Motion changes where things are, not what they are, and is therefore a symmetry of the data. Yet standard recurrent networks are not equivariant to it: their memory stays put while the input moves on. Flow equivariant recurrent networks first brought this symmetry into sequence models, for motions of constant velocity, or flows, by enumerating a bank of velocities. We extend this idea in three directions: from simple recurrent networks to convolutional LSTMs, from flows to motions whose velocity changes in time, and from enumerating velocities to estimating them. Treating a sequence as a field over time, we show that motion becomes a gauge symmetry: a global symmetry made local in time. translated_title: 运动等变卷积LSTM：当运动成为一种规范对称性
translated_abstract: 物体会移动，相机会平移，天气会随风飘移：序列数据中许多变化都是运动。运动改变的是事物的位置，而非事物本身，因此它是数据的一种对称性。然而，标准的循环网络对运动不具备等变性：当输入在移动时，它们的记忆却停留在原地。流等变循环网络首次将这种对称性引入序列模型，针对恒定速度的运动（即流），通过枚举一组速度来实现。我们在三个方向上扩展了这一思想：从简单循环网络扩展到卷积LSTM，从恒定速度流扩展到速度随时间变化的运动，以及从枚举速度扩展到估计速度。将序列视为定义在时间上的场，我们证明运动成为一种规范对称性：一种在时间上被局域化的全局对称性。基于这一观点，我们的运动等变卷积LSTM（MELSTM）将其速度模型作为规范场，并且可以证明其具有等变性……
tldr: 提出运动等变卷积LSTM（MELSTM），将运动视为时间上局域化的规范对称性，通过估计时变速度而非枚举速度，使网络记忆能够随输入的运动而等变地移动。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Motion Equivariant Convolutional LSTM (MELSTM), which treats motion as a gauge symmetry localized in time, extending flow equivariance to convolutional LSTMs with time-varying, estimated velocities so that the network's memory moves equivariantly with its input.
